title: lyonia doyonensis
intro: Lyonia doyonensis, commonly known as Doyon's lyonia or mountain holly, is a plant species in the heath family (Ericaceae). It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lyonia doyonensis include wound healing, anti-cancer activities, and the regulation of blood sugar levels. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
